maddeler.e:
أرتكز (form VIII)
# أَرْتَكِزُ (ʔartakizu) /ʔar.ta.ki.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَكَزَ (irtakaza)
# أَرْتَكِزَ (ʔartakiza) /ʔar.ta.ki.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَكَزَ (irtakaza)
# أَرْتَكِزْ (ʔartakiz) /ʔar.ta.kiz/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَكَزَ (irtakaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
